# The concept registry: every idea more than one app needs has ONE owner,
# a block or an app (apps are blocks too, zxapp.h C1), and every other app
# reaches it with "use <owner> <major>", never by writing it again.
# tools/apps/concepts.py --check fails when a manifest provides a name a
# concept here owns, or when two manifests provide the same name and it is
# neither a concept nor a local word (last section).

column2: owner (manifest.entry, or zxvd:<method> for a daemon method)

column4: share of a capacity in use, in hundredths of a percent: floor(10000 * (total - left) / total); refused when total is 0 or left is more than total
each size's share of the sum of the total vector, in hundredths of a percent: floor(10000 * size / sum of total), a zero sum counted as 1
whole days in a count of seconds: floor(seconds / 86400)
hours past the last whole day: floor(seconds mod 86400 / 3600)
the greatest common divisor of two integers, never negative
each agent's share of a swarm cycle's tokens
the busiest agent in a swarm cycle
a swarm share and intensity inside the owner's limits
net present value of integer cash flows at a rational rate
whether a seller's minimum and a buyer's maximum overlap

a 16-bit sample scaled by a level in hundredths of a percent (10000 is unity): floor(sample * level / 10000), the floor toward minus infinity, then held inside -32768..32767 (saturating, never wrapped); level is one value for the whole buffer; a sample outside 16 bits or a level outside 0..1000000 is refused as -32769

how long a count of samples of one channel lasts at a rate in hertz, in milliseconds: samples * 1000 / rate as an exact reduced rational, never rounded; a rate of 0 is refused, and so is a product that does not fit int64
